rule: A box is marked only on the query image, only when an operator can point to one instance of that task on the site under watch. A neighboring building is not that instance. An unmarked frame is no_exemplar_marked. The box is not ground truth for the other objects.

s-dev-earth-1:window.reason: The site is open ground. Windows are on a neighboring finished building.

s-dev-earth-1:window_opening.reason: No window opening on the site.

s-dev-earth-1:door.reason: No door on the site. Doors on the neighboring building were not marked.

s-dev-earth-2:window.reason: Same site series as earth-1, earthworks. No operator box.

s-dev-earth-2:window_opening.reason: No operator box on this query image.

s-dev-earth-2:door.reason: No operator box on this query image.

s-dev-frame:window.reason: The site shows timber bays, not glazed windows. Neighbor windows were not used.

s-dev-frame:window_opening.reason: Timber bays are visible, but no operator box was marked, so visual mode was not run.

s-dev-frame:door.reason: No operator box on this query image.

s-dev-empty:window.reason: Crane and yard. No facade window on the site.

s-dev-empty:window_opening.reason: No window opening on the site.

s-dev-empty:door.reason: No building door on the site.

s-dev-early:window.reason: No operator box. An exemplar was not copied from another frame.

s-dev-early:window_opening.reason: No operator box. An exemplar was not copied from another frame.

s-dev-early:door.reason: No operator box. An exemplar was not copied from another frame.
